values.note: Pads are listed at 24 to 59 ft, with site 12 a 112-ft pull-through; sites 2 and 4 are the shortest at 24 ft. Extra vehicles park in the visitor lot, not between sites.

sites.source: https://www.brainerdmn.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Lum-Park-RV-Campground-15 (Site 1 59 feet ... Site 2 24 feet ... Site 4 24 feet ... Site 12 112 foot pull through ... Site 29 45 feet; 'There is no parking between sites; guests and extra vehicles must park in visitor parking.') + site map 7629 (sites 1-29), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://www.brainerdmn.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Lum-Park-RV-Campground-15 ('There are 30 and 50-amp electric and water hook-ups, free Wi-Fi, fire rings and picnic tables at each site.'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.brainerdmn.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Lum-Park-RV-Campground-15 ('There are showers and restrooms available for campsite usage'; 'Dump Station: $5 (no charge to our guests)'; 'free Wi-Fi'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Water, dump station, restrooms and showers shut down in October when freezing nights are possible; electricity and Wi-Fi stay on through October 31.

season.source: https://www.brainerdmn.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Lum-Park-RV-Campground-15 ('The campground is open May 1 to October 31.'; 'Water/dump station/restrooms/showers will be shut down in October when freezing nighttime temperatures are a possibility. Electricity and Wi-Fi are on through October 31.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Online (Rec1), by phone 218-828-2320 or by email; full payment up front. Reservations open January 1. Specific sites are not guaranteed. An unclaimed site may be released after 4 p.m. unless a late check-in was arranged.

booking.source: https://www.brainerdmn.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Lum-Park-RV-Campground-15 ('Make Reservation Online' -> secure.rec1.com/MN/brainerd-parks-recreation-mn/catalog; 'Call: 218-828-2320'; 'Reservations begin on January 1st and generally run through October 10th weather dependent.'; 'Full advance payment is required for all reservations.'; 'specific campsites are not guaranteed'; 'reserves the right to release any site after 4 p.m.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Standard $55 a day ($45 for 65+, military or veteran); weekly $330 ($290). October and April off-season $25 (electricity and Wi-Fi only).

fees.source: https://www.brainerdmn.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Lum-Park-RV-Campground-15 ('Daily Rates (Taxes Included)': 'Standard Daily Rate: $55/day', '65+ / Military / Veteran Rate: $45/day', 'Standard Weekly Rate: $330', '65+ / Military / Veteran Weekly Rate: $290', 'Off-Season rate applies in October and April (electricity/Wi-Fi only): $25'), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Brainerd campground in Lum Park, a city park on Rice Lake with a swimming beach, boat landing and fishing pier; the RV loop sits in the woods south of the lake. No tents. No outside firewood; the host sells it. --Claude
summary: City page read: 29 sites (pads 24-59 ft plus a 112-ft pull-through), 30/50 A + water, showers, Wi-Fi, dump, May 1 - Oct 31, $55 taxes included ($45 65+/military/veteran), $25 off-season, Rec1 online booking. Not waterfront confirmed (loop ~150 m south of Rice Lake). Website to the current brainerdmn.gov URL.
flags: PAGE contradictions (information only): it says 'The campground is open May 1 to October 31' yet prices an April off-season rate; and it says 'We do not offer weekly, monthly or seasonal rates' while listing weekly rates of $330/$290. Season written as May 1 - Oct 31.
Price: $55 a night taxes included (local; price gate does not apply). Every pad is 24 ft or longer, so a 23-ft rig fits any site.

WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: the city's site map 7629 and Esri imagery put the loop (sites 1-29) in woods south of the park lawn, about 150 m from the Rice Lake shore. Pin 46.36931,-94.16409 is inside the loop. No change.
